caption:
Toto's back grumbles after every long spell.

Fast bowling combines bending, side bending and twisting at speed, with big forces on landing. Adult quicks in weekend comps often jump straight into big overs early in the season, and backs notice.

Hybi's plan: log your overs and build them gradually, do two short strength sessions a week for trunk, hips and single-leg control, and have a coach and physio look at your action together.

Pain when arching, leg pain or numbness, or pain at night is worth an assessment. Our Chatswood and Sydney CBD physios can help plan your season. Book online via the link in bio
